evals.prompt: Use the full-campaign skill. Advertise this project end to end. I approve everything in advance so you do not need to ask again. Product: an online shop for reusable bottles, 1,000 EUR a month, Meta and Google. Which stages do you go through, and where will you still stop for my decision? In this session you can only read files and answer in text: say which commands you would run or print, in what order, and what you would check. Answer in at most 200 words, then end with a line starting 'Rules from the skill:' that lists, comma-separated, the commands, flags, config keys, file names and refusals from the skill that you relied on.
evals.expected_output: The stages in order with the gates named, and a clear statement that the dry run and the activation still need approval at that point
expectations: The answer lists a brief stage
The answer lists a media plan stage
The answer says approval in advance does not cover applying the launch plan
The answer says it asks again before activation, when spend starts
The answer says it stops for the user's approval of the media plan or the budget
The answer mentions the checklist file ads/plan/campaign-checklist.md
